additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422101-DC/Si-D/MC-[ Y2/R9 313202799090 ] "VendorErrorCode": "secc is offline" CRM:02684000193
additional_info.body:
Hello Cedric,
Greetings of the day!
Currently we can see the charger is healthy and is online on both backends.
We observed following in logs -
Sun, 04 May 2025 12:00:14 GMT
2025-05-04, 12:00:14
2025-05-04T12:00:14.022846+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:err] ecog-secc-adapter/8a147c1060bf[638]:
Error polling coap://10.20.17.100
:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s
Sun, 04 May 2025 12:00:15 GMT
2025-05-04, 12:00:15
2025-05-04T12:00:15.353520+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/b1abc37f7d48[638]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (eb675aa4-afc9-4984-b264-bd84fecc8d1d) - {"connectorId":2,"errorCode":"OtherError","status":"Faulted","vendorId":"SICHARGE D","vendorErrorCode":"
secc is offline"
}
The
"VendorErrorCode": “secc is offline”
is due to Error polling coap.
Error polling coap indicates -Internal communication to SECC (Ecog) lost for small interval of time.
SiC D will reconnect to SECC within 5 seconds. While SECC is not reachable, an "Outlet out of order" flag will be active and will be cleared out as soon as the SiC D reconnects to SECC.
Kindly let us know if the same error appears again. We will then inform our service to take appropriate action accordingly.
Do let us know if you have any other queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
